mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_account WHERE id = #{id} AND account_type = 'admin'
SELECT * FROM user_account WHERE username = #{username} AND account_type = 'admin'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_account (username, password_hash, account_type, role, status, real_name, phone, email, email_hash) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, 'admin', #{role}, #{status}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{emailHash})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_account SET username = #{username}, password_hash = COALESCE(#{password}, password_hash), real_name = #{realName}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, email_hash = #{emailHash}, role = #{role}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND account_type = 'admin'
